title: 第15章 被拦第16章 李倩儿
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
回到洞府后，宁知初开始了有条不紊的修炼生活。
白天练剑，剑气在院中纵横；下午研习术法，各种小法术信手拈来；到了晚上，就一边睡觉一边运转自创的睡梦修炼法。
她并不急着提升境界，而是像打磨玉石般反复锤炼自己的根基。
灵力被一次次压缩，丹田和经脉在这样日复一日的打磨下，变得越发宽广坚韧。
只有当感觉到达极限时，才会选择突破。
辟谷丹成了日常主食，但吃久了实在腻味。
等有空了得学学炼丹，宁知初咬着丹药想，至少得炼点草莓味、芒果味的...
三年光阴转瞬即逝。
如今的宁知初已是炼气三层，最得意的是剑法已然能凝练出剑芒——这可是许多筑基修士都做不到的。
这日，她决定去宗门后山转转，顺便试试这三年的修炼成果。
收拾好行装，就出发了。
后山是弟子们常去的试炼之地。
修为低的在外围活动，强者才敢深入内围。
宁知初对自己的实力心里有数，只打算在外围转转。
路上遇见三三两两的修士，有的结伴而行，有的独自赶路。
宁知初脚步轻快，独自行走在路上。
看来这去后山的人还真不少呢~，宁知初低声叹道，随后不紧不慢地往后山走去。
说是后山，实际上是一片望不到边的原始森林，远远望去云雾缭绕，宛如仙境。
不过宁知初可清楚得很，这美景下面藏着全是危险。
她谨慎地在外围区域转悠，一路上倒是没遇见什么凶猛的妖兽，反倒是发现了不少低阶灵植。

宁知初也不气馁，反倒东采采西摘摘，不一会儿储物袋就装了不少低阶灵植。
这个止血草不错~
呀，居然有清心花！
咦？这不是炼制聚气丹的主药吗？
她一边采摘一边念叨，这些灵植虽然都是低阶不值什么钱，可这些都是练习炼丹的好材料，省得以后还要去坊市买了。
走着走着，宁知初突然停下脚步，竖起耳朵仔细听了听：好像有水声？她循着声音找去，果然发现了一处清澈见底的小溪。
溪边长满了各种灵植，在阳光下闪着莹莹微光。
今天运气真不错！
她开心地拍了拍手，又开始了新一轮的采集。
宁知初正悠闲地采着灵草，忽然左前方的草丛作响。
她立刻警觉起来，神识一扫，却忍不住了一声——原来是一只雪白的疾风兔！
这小家伙毛茸茸的，两只长耳朵高高竖起，红宝石般的眼睛滴溜溜转着，粉嫩的小鼻子不停地嗅来嗅去，把草丛拱得一晃一晃的，可爱极了。
宁知初虽然对毛茸茸的小动物毫无抵抗力，好想rua一把啊...宁知初心里痒痒的，但在修仙界，宁知初还是长了个心眼，知道不能被它表象所迷惑，越好看越危险，所以宁知初并未动。
她屏住呼吸，静静地观察着。
突然，那兔子像察觉到什么似的，直起身子朝她这边望来。
一人一兔就这样大眼瞪小眼地对上了。
噗...宁知初差点笑出声，却见那兔子瞬间警觉，见她没有动作，地化作一道白影从眼前掠过，速度快得惊人。
不愧是疾风兔啊！
content_en:
After returning to the cave, Ning Zhichu began a methodical life of cultivation.
During the day, he practiced swordsmanship, and the sword energy spread freely in the courtyard; in the afternoon, he studied spells, and all kinds of small spells were at his fingertips; at night, he used his self-created sleep cultivation method while sleeping.
She is not in a hurry to improve her realm, but instead repeatedly refines her foundation like polishing jade.
The spiritual power was compressed again and again, and the Dantian and meridians became broader and stronger under such polishing day after day.
Only when you feel that you have reached your limit will you choose to break through.
Bigu Dan has become a daily staple food, but after eating it for a long time, it becomes boring.
I have to learn how to make elixirs when I have time. Ning Zhichu bit the elixir and thought, at least make some strawberry-flavored or mango-flavored ones...
Three years have passed by in a blink of an eye.
Ning Zhichu is now at the third level of Qi Refining, and what he is most proud of is that his sword skills can already condense the sword light - something that many foundation-building monks cannot do.
On this day, she decided to go to the back mountain of the sect and try out the results of the past three years of cultivation.
Packed up the luggage and set off.
The back mountain is a place where disciples often go for training.
Those with low cultivation level move around on the periphery, while the strong ones dare to go deep into the inner periphery.
Ning Zhichu knew his strength well and only planned to hang around on the periphery.
On the road, I met monks in twos and threes, some traveling together, and some traveling alone.
Ning Zhichu walked briskly on the road alone.
It seems that there are quite a lot of people going to the back mountain~, Ning Zhichu sighed in a low voice, and then walked slowly towards the back mountain.
It is said to be the back mountain, but it is actually a primitive forest that can't be seen to the edge. From a distance, it is like a fairyland shrouded in clouds and mist.
But Ning Zhichu knew very well that there were dangers hidden beneath this beautiful scenery.
She cautiously wandered around the outer area, but she didn't encounter any ferocious monsters along the way. Instead, she discovered many low-level spiritual plants.
Ning Zhichu was not discouraged, but instead picked here and there. After a while, the storage bag contained many low-level spiritual plants.
This hemostatic grass is good~
Ah, there is actually a pure heart flower!
Huh? Isn't this the main ingredient for refining the Qi Gathering Pill?
As she picked them, she muttered that although these spiritual plants were low-level and not worth much, they were good materials for practicing alchemy, which would save them from going to the market to buy them in the future.
While walking, Ning Zhichu suddenly stopped and listened carefully: There seemed to be the sound of water? She followed the sound and found a crystal clear stream.
The streamside is covered with various spiritual plants, shimmering in the sunlight.
What a lucky day today!
She clapped her hands happily and started a new round of collecting.
Ning Zhichu was leisurely picking spiritual herbs when suddenly there was a sound in the grass in front of him on the left.
She immediately became alert, her consciousness swept away, but she couldn't help but scream - it turned out to be a snow-white Gale Rabbit!
This little guy is fluffy, with two long ears standing high, ruby-like eyes rolling around, and a pink little nose that keeps sniffing around, shaking the grass. It's so cute.
Although Ning Zhichu had no resistance to the furry little animals, he really wanted to rub them... Ning Zhichu felt itchy in his heart, but in the world of cultivating immortals, Ning Zhichu still had a keen eye and knew not to be fooled by its appearance. The more beautiful it was, the more dangerous it was, so Ning Zhichu did not move.
She held her breath and watched quietly.
Suddenly, the rabbit seemed to notice something, straightened up and looked towards her.
One person and one rabbit just faced each other with big eyes and small eyes.
Pfft... Ning Zhichu almost laughed out loud, but saw that the rabbit was instantly alert. Seeing that she didn't move, the ground turned into a white shadow and passed by in front of her eyes at an alarming speed.
As expected of the Gale Rabbit!
